### 1. Summary
The incident involves a change in the image version of the cart-api deployment and high CPU throttling in the monitoring namespace.

### 2. Affected resources
- Deployment/shop/cart-api — image version drift
- kind=PrometheusAlert name=CPUThrottlingHigh severity=info state=firing namespace=monitoring

### 3. Root cause
The root cause appears to be an unintentional update of the cart-api deployment image to a newer version (2.3.2) which may have introduced performance issues leading to high CPU throttling in the monitoring namespace.

### 4. Causal chain
1. An update to the cart-api image was made outside of Helm, causing a drift in the declared and observed image versions.
2. The updated image (2.3.2) may have performance issues that are causing high CPU usage.
3. The high CPU usage triggers the CPUThrottlingHigh Prometheus alert in the monitoring namespace.

### 5. Remediation
- Roll back the cart-api deployment to the previous image version (2.3.1) using Helm:
  ```
  helm rollback shop/cart-api 1
  ```
- Investigate the cause of the image update and implement measures to prevent such updates outside of Helm in the future.

### 6. Confidence
MEDIUM - While the image drift is confirmed, the causal link between the image update and the high CPU throttling is inferred rather than directly observed.

### 7. Checks
- Verify the cart-api deployment image version after rollback:
  ```
  kubectl get deployment shop/cart-api -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}'
  ```
- Confirm the resolution of the CPUThrottlingHigh alert:
  ```
  kubectl get PrometheusAlert -n monitoring -w
  ```
- Investigate the cause of the image update using logs or other diagnostic commands as needed.
